texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 1.Choosing installation site
texts.text: 1.Choosing installation site

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Here are some suggestions for wind turbine installation site selection:
texts.text: Here are some suggestions for wind turbine installation site selection:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1.) Wind energy is proportional to the cube of wind speed, Therefore, wind turbines should be installed in places with large annual wind speeds. In addition, the wind speed is also higher as it is usually higher from the ground, so the wind turbine is installed as high as possible.
texts.text: 1.) Wind energy is proportional to the cube of wind speed, Therefore, wind turbines should be installed in places with large annual wind speeds. In addition, the wind speed is also higher as it is usually higher from the ground, so the wind turbine is installed as high as possible.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2.) Recommended installation height: In the place without obstruction, the center of the wind wheel is more than 6 meters above the ground. When installing on the roof platform, the center of the wind wheel should be more than 2 meters above the retaining wall, so that the wind wheel does not cover the wind.
texts.text: 2.) Recommended installation height: In the place without obstruction, the center of the wind wheel is more than 6 meters above the ground. When installing on the roof platform, the center of the wind wheel should be more than 2 meters above the retaining wall, so that the wind wheel does not cover the wind.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3.) When the wind encounters obstacles such as buildings or trees, it will form turbulent flow, which not only affects the power generation effect, but also poses a threat to the operation of the wind turbine. Therefore, the site should avoid large obstacles.suggestions below:
texts.text: 3.) When the wind encounters obstacles such as buildings or trees, it will form turbulent flow, which not only affects the power generation effect, but also poses a threat to the operation of the wind turbine. Therefore, the site should avoid large obstacles.suggestions below:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You should choose a place where the terrain is flat and open, where there is no obstruction to the airflow, or where it is selected to increase the velocity of the airflow. Within 100 meters around the wind turbine tower, there should be no obstacles of more than 8 meters.Within 30 meters around the tower,there should be no obstacles of more than 3 meters. If
texts.text: You should choose a place where the terrain is flat and open, where there is no obstruction to the airflow, or where it is selected to increase the velocity of the airflow. Within 100 meters around the wind turbine tower, there should be no obstacles of more than 8 meters.Within 30 meters around the tower,there should be no obstacles of more than 3 meters. If

texts.label: text
texts.orig: the obstacle must be installed close to the obstacle, the height of the tower should be more than 2 times the height of the obstacle.
texts.text: the obstacle must be installed close to the obstacle, the height of the tower should be more than 2 times the height of the obstacle.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4.) The tower should be in the downwind position in the local environment to ensure that the wind turbine rotor is in the windward position for most of the time, improving power generation.
texts.text: 4.) The tower should be in the downwind position in the local environment to ensure that the wind turbine rotor is in the windward position for most of the time, improving power generation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5.) Site selection should avoid frequent areas such as storms, hail, lightning and other disasters.
texts.text: 5.) Site selection should avoid frequent areas such as storms, hail, lightning and other disasters.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 6.) The wind turbine should be installed in a solid place to ensure the foundation is reliable, otherwise the foundation should be strengthened.
texts.text: 6.) The wind turbine should be installed in a solid place to ensure the foundation is reliable, otherwise the foundation should be strengthened.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 7.) Installation of wind turbines should be kept away from transmission lines and communication lines, and comply with the relevant regulations and requirements of the locality. If possible, install the wind turbine as much as possible for easy viewing.
